hypothesis: A second anchored epoch tests whether further GRPO steps add anything once drift is controlled, or whether the policy simply sits at its warm-start.
technique: Same KL-anchored GRPO run as epoch 1 (cached rollouts/rewards/advantages, beta=1.0 anchor to the frozen v2a_e1 warm-start), one epoch further — epoch 2.
result: Scored 0.378 on the full-30 gate (2 win / 1 tie / 26 loss), below epoch 1 (0.407) and the base; naturalness held 4 and refusals stayed 1 (no drift), but coverage stayed 3. Confirms the anchored policy does not improve with more steps — it converges to the warm-start and the coverage wall holds. Discarded.
